threads.body:
@copilot Simplify the new WebFlux proxy-handler test in this PR. Update this PR directly, not a separate follow-up PR.

In instrumentation/spring/spring-webflux/spring-webflux-5.0/testing/src/main/java/io/opentelemetry/instrumentation/spring/webflux/server/AbstractSpringWebfluxTest.java, make the existing client field and registered static testing extension protected so subclasses can reuse them. Keep the superclass port private and keep the existing @BeforeEach client initialization and extension registration.

In SpringWebfluxTest.java under the javaagent test sources, use the inherited client for the /proxy-handler request and the inherited testing extension for waitAndAssertTraces. Remove the duplicate @Value port field, the local AgentInstrumentationExtension.create() call, and imports made unused by these changes. Preserve the existing response and telemetry assertions and the proxied-handler fixture.

Keep ForceSingleThreadedNettyAutoConfiguration extending SpringWebfluxTest.ForceNettyAutoConfiguration and its nettyFactory override. The threaded subclass inherits this test and needs the proxy-handler beans while retaining its single-threaded server.

Do not change production span-name behavior or unrelated tests. Run the narrowest relevant spotlessApply task before relevant validation, and exercise the proxy-handler test in both SpringWebfluxTest and SpringThreadedSpringWebfluxTest using the repository's documented test setup.

replies.body: Updated in 4e2123fb. The proxy-handler test now uses the inherited client and extension, and passes in both WebFlux test classes.
